## Problem and change

Explain what was wrong or missing and what the user sees after this change.
Link the issue if there is one.

## Validation

List checks you actually ran and their results. For behavior bugs, include the
reproduction or regression test. For UI changes, describe browser, narrow-screen
and keyboard checks; add screenshots when helpful.

## Limits and documentation

Identify unfinished integration or untested behavior. Update the relevant guide
and distinguish working features from planned ones.

- [ ] I reviewed the staged diff for unrelated files and secrets.
- [ ] I updated examples/contracts affected by this change.
- [ ] I requested an independent review.
